mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (student_no, email, password, nickname, avatar, gender, phone, wechat, whatsapp, dorm_area, ban_publish, ban_chat, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{studentNo}, #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{wechat}, #{whatsapp}, #{dormArea}, #{banPublish}, #{banChat}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM member
AND (student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY create_time DESC
